findings.title: Image brightness outside preferred range
findings.reason: The average grayscale brightness is outside the provisional acquisition range.
findings.recommendation: Check lighting, camera angle and exposure before interpreting product quality.

findings.title: Low focus reliability
findings.reason: Insufficient edge definition can reduce the reliability of texture and surface findings.
findings.recommendation: Clean the lens, stabilize the camera and refocus.

findings.title: Exposure clipping detected
findings.reason: A significant fraction of pixels has lost detail in dark or bright regions.
findings.recommendation: Reduce reflections or adjust illumination and exposure.

findings.title: Color variation requires review
findings.reason: LAB channel variation is higher than the provisional uniformity threshold.
findings.recommendation: Review mixing uniformity and compare with an approved Golden Batch.

findings.title: Texture uniformity below preferred level
findings.reason: Local grayscale variation indicates an uneven visual texture.
findings.recommendation: Inspect mixing stage, product surface and camera reflections.

findings.title: Possible elevated bubble-like regions
findings.reason: Circular structures were detected, but folds and reflections can create false candidates.
findings.recommendation: Request manual review and select the correct process stage before making a batch decision.

findings.title: Possible oily or highly reflective regions
findings.reason: Low-saturation bright areas exceed the provisional candidate threshold.
findings.recommendation: Inspect the product surface and eliminate lighting reflection as a cause.
